Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association

Igarashi Sake Brewery's annual New Sake Festival will be held.

Date and time: Saturday, December 5, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 10:00–15:00
Venue: Igarashi Sake Brewery (667–1 Kawadera, Hanno, Saitama)

Shuttle buses run regularly from the south exit of Hanno Station.

Activities and attractions:
• Limited-edition new sake sales
• Free new sake tasting (one tasting per person)
• Free sweet sake (amazake)
• Sake bar
• Many food and drink vendor booths
summary: 🎪 Igarashi Sake Brewery New Sake Festival – December 5, 2026
